blocks: 1. Select one or more lines.

custom_steps.text:

blocks: 1. The bar sits at the top of the list and replaces the column headers while a selection is active; nothing on the page shifts when it appears.
2. Selecting a row highlights the whole line, including its story, labour and parts.

3. Layout is: "n selected", then Deselect all, then the line actions, then the parts actions, then More, then a close control - with a divider after "n selected", after the line group and after the parts group, always in those places.
4. Each action follows one rule: nothing in the selection qualifies -> hidden; something qualifies but is blocked -> shown disabled with the reason; qualifies and not blocked -> shown with its count.
5. Line actions count lines and parts actions count parts ("Receive 5 parts" may come from two lines); a count never includes what the action would skip.

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8683 and story SV-9253 (Story 7, The bulk action bar) and the Simple Flow V2 specification (Confluence page 771391574, revised 8 September 2026), read on 8 September 2026.
Last checked against build v26.35.9-5700a76 on 9/9/2026.
